narration.en: The skin on your palm, the lining of your mouth and the walls of the tiny air sacs in your lungs are all made of one kind of tissue, arranged in different ways.
narration.kn: ಅಂಗೈ ಚರ್ಮ, ಬಾಯಿಯ ಒಳಪದರ ಮತ್ತು ಶ್ವಾಸಕೋಶದ ಗಾಳಿಚೀಲಗಳ ಗೋಡೆ ಎಲ್ಲವೂ ಒಂದೇ ಬಗೆಯ ಅಂಗಾಂಶದಿಂದ, ಬೇರೆ ಬೇರೆ ರೀತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿವೆ.

body.en: Epithelial tissue has a free surface facing a body fluid or the outside, and its cells are compactly packed with little intercellular matrix. Simple epithelium is a single layer. Squamous epithelium of thin flat cells lines blood vessels and the air sacs of the lungs and forms a diffusion boundary. Cuboidal epithelium lines the ducts of glands and the tubular parts of nephrons, where it helps in secretion and absorption; in the proximal convoluted tubule it has microvilli. Columnar epithelium of tall cells with basal nuclei lines the stomach and intestine. Ciliated epithelium moves particles or mucus in one direction, as in the bronchioles and fallopian tubes.
body.kn: ಏಕಪದರದ ಉಪಕಲೆ: ಚಪ್ಪಟೆ (ರಕ್ತನಾಳ, ಗಾಳಿಚೀಲ), ಘನಾಕಾರ (ಗ್ರಂಥಿ ನಾಳ, ನೆಫ್ರಾನ್ ನಳಿಕೆ), ಸ್ತಂಭಾಕಾರ (ಜಠರ, ಕರುಳು), ಸೀಲಿಯಾಯುಕ್ತ (ಶ್ವಾಸನಳಿಕೆ, ಅಂಡನಾಳ).

say.en: Simple epithelium is one layer of cells. Squamous cells are thin and flat, as in the air sacs.
Cuboidal cells are cube-shaped, lining gland ducts and nephron tubules.
Columnar cells are tall with basal nuclei, lining the stomach and intestine.
Ciliated cells carry cilia that sweep mucus, as in the bronchioles.
Compound epithelium has many layers and protects, as in the skin.
Cells are joined by junctions: tight junctions stop leaks, adhering ones cement, gap junctions link cytoplasm.

right.en: Walls of blood vessels and air sacs of lungs
Proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron
Inner surface of bronchioles and fallopian tubes
Dry surface of the skin and moist lining of the buccal cavity
Goblet cells of the alimentary canal

explanation.en: Simple epithelium is one layer thick and suits diffusion, absorption and secretion. Compound epithelium has many layers and protects against chemical and mechanical stress.

body.en: Some columnar or cuboidal cells become specialised for secretion. Unicellular glands are single cells, like the goblet cells of the alimentary canal; multicellular glands are clusters of cells, like the salivary gland. Exocrine glands release mucus, saliva, earwax, oil, milk and digestive enzymes through ducts. Endocrine glands have no ducts and release hormones directly into the fluid bathing the gland.
body.kn: ಏಕಕೋಶ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ: ಗಾಬ್ಲೆಟ್ ಕೋಶ; ಬಹುಕೋಶ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ: ಲಾಲಾರಸ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ. ಬಹಿಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು ನಾಳಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅಂತಃಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು ನಾಳವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Some columnar or cuboidal cells become specialised for secretion. Unicellular glands are single cells, like the goblet cells of the alimentary canal; multicellular glands are clusters of cells, like the salivary gland. Exocrine glands release mucus, saliva, earwax, oil, milk and digestive enzymes through ducts.
narration.kn: ಏಕಕೋಶ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ: ಗಾಬ್ಲೆಟ್ ಕೋಶ; ಬಹುಕೋಶ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ: ಲಾಲಾರಸ ಗ್ರಂಥಿ. ಬಹಿಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು ನಾಳಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ಸ್ರವಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಅಂತಃಸ್ರಾವಕ ಗ್ರಂಥಿಗಳು ನಾಳವಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನುಗಳನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಬಿಡುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Compound epithelium has two or more layers; its main function is protection against chemical and mechanical stress. It covers the dry surface of the skin, the moist surface of the buccal cavity and pharynx, and lines the ducts of salivary glands and the pancreas. Cells are linked by junctions: tight junctions stop substances leaking across a tissue, adhering junctions cement neighbouring cells together, and gap junctions connect the cytoplasm of adjoining cells for rapid transfer of ions and small molecules.
body.kn: ಬಹುಪದರದ ಉಪಕಲೆ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ: ಚರ್ಮ, ಬಾಯಿಯ ಕುಹರ. ಕೋಶ ಸಂಧಿಗಳು: ಬಿಗಿ ಸಂಧಿ ಸೋರಿಕೆ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಂಟಿಸುವ ಸಂಧಿ ಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಅಂತರ ಸಂಧಿ ಕೋಶದ್ರವ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

steps.en: (a) Air sacs need fast diffusion: simple squamous epithelium.
(b) Intestine absorbs and secretes: columnar epithelium with microvilli.
(c) PCT: cuboidal epithelium with microvilli. (d) Bronchioles move mucus: ciliated epithelium.
